name: scene-picking-visual
description: Redesign P2: hovering and clicking scene entities (raycaster over terrain + entity meshes). Hover a placed building — the debounced hover tag should show its name and HP; click it — a selection ring should appear on the ground and the inspector should show Research (tier 2 locked)/Move/Demolish; Esc deselects — both disappear; hovering bare terrain shows tile coordinates and 'no survey data'. Also covers the employee side of the same picker (parity with the retired playtest 'scene-picking' definition): selecting a hired employee by clicking them in the 3D scene (clickEntity, not a panel row) and opening their crew detail via the inspector's DETAIL action.

steps.description: Setup: a fresh site with open ground around the origin

Setup for the employee side of the picker: hire a driller (parity with the retired playtest 'scene-picking' definition) Hired ahead of the order below rather than after it (#556): a build order is queued work now, so the site needs someone on the roster to walk over and build it. Opens the Crew panel with ensurePanel rather than a bare toolbar click (#556): the toolbar tab toggles, so when a preceding step has already opened the panel a second click closes it and the hire button underneath reports zero size.

expect.note: HIRING_COSTS.driller is 1000 (balance.ts); cash was 42000 after the management_office purchase above

steps.description: Setup: place a building at a known tile — its footprint centre (11, 14) is the click target
Let the queued construction site(s) be walked to and built out (#556): ordering a building no longer places it, so everything below that needs a standing building waits here first.

Walk the driller clear of the office it just built (#556). Construction relocates the builder off the finished footprint onto the nearest walkable tile — right up against the building — and the employee pick further down then lands on the office instead of the crew member, so the inspector never offers DETAIL at all.
Let the driller finish that walk before the picking steps below.
Frame the building dead-centre, then hover it — the tag should appear once the 60ms debounce settles, showing the building's name and HP
Click the building — a dashed selection ring appears on the ground and the inspector shows Research (tier 2 is still locked, so Upgrade is replaced by it)/Move/Demolish

expect.note: waitForSelector above proved the Research button exists in the DOM; blocked proves it is disabled (no Research Center yet), not covered/hidden

steps.description: Esc deselects — the ring and the inspector both disappear

expect.note: Esc hides the inspector entirely, so its buttons must no longer be reachable

steps.description: Hover bare terrain away from the building — the tag shows tile coordinates and 'no survey data' (nothing has surveyed this column)
Click the hired driller in the 3D scene (clickEntity by kind+id, not a panel row) — the inspector should show Detail/Dispatch Here/Train for this employee

expect.note: a dashed selection ring should appear on the ground and the inspector should show the clicked employee's detail

steps.description: The inspector itself carries the employee's detail (no DETAIL hop): skills and actions are already there for this exact employee

expect.note: the inspector must show this exact employee's detail

steps.description: Close the inspector with its own close (x) button; it is the only element carrying the panel-close attribute

expect.note: closing the inspector must make its actions unreachable again, same invariant as the Esc-deselects building check above
